frameworks.name: SFIA 9
frameworks.use: Original customer wording informed by progression in autonomy, complexity and responsibility, and by professional skill areas including development, testing, service operations and stakeholder relationships.

frameworks.name: European Skills, Competences, Qualifications and Occupations (ESCO)
frameworks.use: Original skill labels, alternate labels and task descriptions informed by the ESCO distinction between knowledge and demonstrable skills or competences.

basis.adaptation: K4 and K3 are Kestrel Cloud test scales, not official SFIA levels, SFIA certifications or verbatim ESCO descriptors; technology names are customer specialisms rather than claimed exact framework concept mappings.
basis.acceptance_rule: K4 uses a tolerance of one level for Yes; K3 requires an exact level match, always conditional on the person actually having the skill.
basis.mapping_policy: Aliases are candidates, not proof; resolve ambiguous phrases using the evidence quote, and hold unmatched or unresolved phrases for review rather than forcing a match.
basis.boundaries: Do not infer Java from JavaScript, TypeScript from JavaScript, PySpark from Python, or tool proficiency from a related practice; each skill needs its own evidence.
basis.k3_policy: The sales and customer success family starts at guided application, then independent application, then leading or teaching; knowledge-only evidence is below K3 level 1 and must be held.
basis.sap_policy: SAP is intentionally one umbrella skill for ambiguity testing; keep the evidenced module in the citation and never imply FI, SD or HCM breadth from another module.
basis.excel_policy: Excel modelling is a non-generic finance practice requiring linked assumptions, formulas, scenarios and reconciliation; ordinary Excel or MS Office use remains excluded.
basis.decay_policy: Decay hints are configurable recency windows in years, not automatic expiry or evidence of absence; tools and languages use two years, domains and practices including soft skills use five years.
basis.evidence_policy: Lines describe observable work or assessed demonstrations, not title, tenure or mention counts; hints are artifact pointers, not sufficient send criteria, and authored content requires customer opt-in and author verification.
basis.approval_status: Synthetic test fixture; no real customer or HR approval is claimed.

levels.name: Guides others
